snippet.title: The Canon Keeper Trailer
snippet.description:
The Canon Keeper is a dark, narrative-driven document inspection game set in a dystopian future where the government has destroyed the Bible and begun rewriting Scripture.

You work underground with the resistance, examining recovered passages and deciding what is real Scripture and what has been altered. Use reference tools, inspect documents, pray for guidance, and make decisions that can affect the underground church and the people depending on you.

This gameplay trailer gives you a look at the core gameplay, atmosphere, and choices you'll face in The Canon Keeper.

If the game looks interesting, wishlist The Canon Keeper on Steam. Wishlists make a huge difference for indie games and help support the project.
